note: Both sets read the same five spanwise curves, but Set B's values track the plotted curves more closely: chord 5.1 m at the root, ~5.8 m near r/R=0.25, ~0.6 m at the tip, prebend 0/-1/-4 m, and pitch-axis location 50/29/37 % all match the figures. Set A introduces clear misreads such as chord 1.5 m at r/R=1.0 (the tip chord is ~0.5-0.6 m), twist 14 deg at the root (~15.5 deg), relative thickness 95% at the root (curve starts at 100%), and relative thickness 40% at r/R=0.25 (~35%), plus several conflicting duplicates (twist 14/15/15.5 at root, thickness 95/100 at root, chord 0.5/0.6/1.5 at tip). Set B is not clean either — it duplicates prebend 0 m and pitch-axis 50% at the root, and gives near-duplicate conflicting values (chord 5.7 vs 5.8 m at 0.25, pitch axis 37 vs 38% at 1.0, chord 5.0 vs 5.1 m at root) and an off-value chord 5.2 m at r/R=0.2 — but its errors are smaller and fewer. Both sets also include a few claims whose quotes are only axis labels rather than supporting text.
